rows.question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu analipwa dola 500 za Marekani kwa mwezi, NSSF yake ni ngapi?
rows.gold_sw: Mshahara umetajwa kwa dola za Marekani (USD 500), siyo shilingi. NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa TZS. Lazima ubadilishe USD 500 kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha ubadilishaji cha siku kabla ya kukokotoa. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa mshahara wa USD 500, unahitaji kuubadili kuwa shilingi za Kitanzania ili kuhesabu NSSF. Thibitisha kiwango cha ubadilishaji wa sasa na benki yako au tovuti ya BoT. Kisha hesabu asilimia 20 ya shilingi hizo. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu NSSF, tafadhali badilisha kiasi kuwa shilingi za Tanzania (TZS) — kiasi ulichotaja kiko katika sarafu ya kigeni. Kisha nitahesabu.
rows.adjudication: foreign currency (USD 500). The GOLD is itself a clarification — it instructs the user to convert to TZS first. v16 asks exactly that. Judge calls v15 WRONG (v15 quoted 20% without a conversion).

rows.question_sw: Tuna wafanyakazi wengi sana karibu, lakini hasa ni 18 wenye mshahara wa TZS 480,000 kila mmoja — NSSF ya wote?
rows.gold_sw: Tumia takwimu hasa: 18 x TZS 480,000 = TZS 8,640,000 jumla ya mishahara. NSSF ni asilimia 20 (mwajiri + mfanyakazi) = TZS 1,728,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: NSSF ya wafanyakazi 18 wenye mshahara wa TZS 480,000 kila mmoja: kila mmoja anachangia TZS 96,000 (20% ya TZS 480,000). Jumla ya michango yao yote: TZS 96,000 × 18 = TZS 1,728,000. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu NSSF, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.
rows.adjudication: 'wafanyakazi wengi sana karibu, lakini HASA NI 18 wenye mshahara wa TZS 480,000 kila mmoja' — both inputs are stated and has_precision_override() already returns True, so the vague/approximate hedge is handled. parse_count still returns None because the digit is followed by 'wenye', not a people-noun. Judge calls v15 CORRECT. A GENUINE REGRESSION.

rows.question_sw: Mshahara wake ni mkubwa kidogo, unafika TZS 920,000 hivi — PAYE yake ni ngapi?
rows.gold_sw: Tumia TZS 920,000. Iko kwenye kundi la nne: PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% ya (920,000 - 760,000) = 68,000 + 40,000 = TZS 108,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 920,000, PAYE ni karibu TZS 90,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw: Ili nikuhesabie makato ya mshahara (kama PAYE, NSSF, SDL) kwa usahihi, nahitaji kiasi cha mshahara au jumla ya mishahara kwa mwezi. Tafadhali niambie mshahara ni shilingi ngapi, kisha nitakuletea hesabu kamili.
rows.adjudication: 'unafika TZS 920,000 HIVI' — the amount parses fine; the approximation veto (detect_approximation) fires on 'hivi'/'kidogo' and blocks the compute. The gold uses 920,000 as stated. Judge calls v15 WRONG (v15 guessed ~90,000 against a gold of 108,000), so the row is a scorer false-pass, not a real loss — but the veto is miscalibrated here.

rows.question_sw: Analipwa TZS 320,000 kila wiki mbili (bi-weekly), NSSF yake ya mwezi ni ngapi?
rows.gold_sw: Malipo ni ya kila wiki mbili, hivyo nihitaji mshahara halisi wa mwezi kwanza (mfano malipo mawili kwa mwezi ni TZS 640,000, lakini hii inategemea kalenda). Toa mshahara wa mwezi ndipo nikokotoe NSSF (10% ya mfanyakazi). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 320,000 kwa wiki mbili, mwezi una viwango VITATU: (1) TZS 0 hadi 270,000 → 0%; (2) TZS 270,001 hadi 320,000 → 8% (TZS 50,000); (3) Zaidi ya TZS 320,000 → 20% (TZS 64,000). Jumla ya NSSF ya mwezi = TZS 114,000 (si 120,000). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu NSSF, niambie mshahara wa MWEZI ni kiasi gani — kiasi ulichotaja ni cha kipindi au kazi moja, si cha mwezi mzima. Kisha nitahesabu.
rows.adjudication: bi-weekly TZS 320,000. The GOLD clarifies and says so explicitly: the monthly figure 'inategemea kalenda'. Pattern D must NOT close this. v16's new copy (item 4, bb30e25) now asks the right question. Judge: v15 WRONG.

rows.question_sw: Fundi analipwa TZS 1,500 kwa kipande, anatengeneza vipande 400 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake?
rows.gold_sw: Mshahara wa mwezi = 1,500 x 400 = TZS 600,000. Iko kwenye kundi la tatu: PAYE = TZS 20,000 + 20% ya (600,000 - 520,000) = 20,000 + 16,000 = TZS 36,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa kipande kimoja: TZS 1,500 ÷ 100 = TZS 15. Kwa vipande 400: TZS 15 × 400 = TZS 6,000. Kwa sababu TZS 6,000 ipo ndani ya bendi ya asilimia sifuri (0%), PAYE = TZS 0. Hakuna PAYE inayolipwa kwa fundi huyu.
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu PAYE, niambie mshahara wa MWEZI ni kiasi gani — kiasi ulichotaja ni cha kipindi au kazi moja, si cha mwezi mzima. Kisha nitahesabu.
rows.adjudication: rate x quantity with an explicit monthly quantity (TZS 1,500/piece x 400 pieces/month). Pattern D territory; deferred by instruction. Judge: v15 WRONG (v15 divided by 100 and answered TZS 0).

rows.question_sw: Dereva analipwa TZS 80,000 kwa safari, anafanya safari 15 kwa mwezi — SDL inahesabuje?
rows.gold_sw: Mshahara wa dereva kwa mwezi ni 80,000 x 15 = TZS 1,200,000. Lakini SDL hutozwa kwa JUMLA ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi WOTE na tu kama ni 10 au zaidi. Nipe idadi ya wafanyakazi wote na mishahara yao. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Mshahara wa dereva huyu ni TZS 80,000 × 15 = TZS 1,200,000 kwa mwezi. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla hiyo, sawa na TZS 42,000 kwa mwezi. Inalipwa na mwajiri pekee — si kukatwa kwa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu SDL, niambie mshahara wa MWEZI ni kiasi gani — kiasi ulichotaja ni cha kipindi au kazi moja, si cha mwezi mzima, na idadi ya wafanyakazi wote walio kwenye orodha ya mishahara (kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10). Kisha nitahesabu.
rows.adjudication: TZS 80,000/trip x 15 trips. Pattern D would recover TZS 1,200,000, but the GOLD STILL CLARIFIES — SDL needs the whole payroll and the total headcount, neither of which is stated. D improves the copy here; it does not remove the clarification. Judge: v15 WRONG (v15 charged SDL on one driver).

rows.question_sw: Muuzaji analipwa kwa kamisheni, asilimia 5 ya alichouza mwezi — NSSF yake ni ngapi?
rows.gold_sw: Mshahara wa kamisheni hubadilika kila mwezi. NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi halisi aliopata. Nihitaji kiasi halisi cha kamisheni cha mwezi husika (TZS) ndipo nikokotoe. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: NSSF ya muuzaji anayelipwa kwa kamisheni ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara wake mkubwa wa jumla, si asilimia 5 tu. Thibitisha mshahara halisi na NSSF.
rows.v16_sw: Ili nikuhesabie makato ya mshahara (kama PAYE, NSSF, SDL) kwa usahihi, nahitaji kiasi cha mshahara au jumla ya mishahara kwa mwezi. Tafadhali niambie mshahara ni shilingi ngapi, kisha nitakuletea hesabu kamili.
rows.adjudication: commission-based pay ('asilimia 5 ya alichouza'). No monetary base exists in the question at all. The GOLD clarifies. Judge: v15 UNDETERMINED.

rows.question_sw: Analipwa TZS 18,000 kwa siku, anafanya kazi siku 26 kwa mwezi — NSSF yake ya mwezi?
rows.gold_sw: Mshahara wa mwezi = 18,000 x 26 = TZS 468,000. NSSF ya mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 = TZS 46,800 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 18,000 kwa siku, kwa siku 26 za mwezi, jumla ya mshahara = TZS 468,000 (26 × 18,000). NSSF ya mwajiri = TZS 9,360 (asilimia 10 ya TZS 468,000). Thibitisha na NSSF.
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu NSSF, niambie mshahara wa MWEZI ni kiasi gani — kiasi ulichotaja ni cha kipindi au kazi moja, si cha mwezi mzima. Kisha nitahesabu.
rows.adjudication: TZS 18,000/day x 26 days/month. Pattern D territory; deferred. Judge: v15 WRONG (v15 computed 10% of the daily rate, not the monthly).

rows.question_sw: Kama nikizingatia kwamba wafanyakazi wangu, ambao ni 14 wanaopata kila mmoja TZS 500,000, wanastahili NSSF, je jumla ni ngapi na SDL yao pia?
rows.gold_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: 14 x TZS 500,000 = TZS 7,000,000. NSSF: 20% = TZS 1,400,000. SDL: wafanyakazi 14 zaidi ya 10, 3.5% ya TZS 7,000,000 = TZS 245,000. Thibitisha na NSSF/TRA.
rows.v15_sw: Kwa wafanyakazi 14 wanaolipwa TZS 500,000 kila mmoja, NSSF itakuwa TZS 140,000 kwa kila mmoja (20% ya mshahara). Jumla ya michango ya NSSF ni TZS 1,960,000. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara, sawa na TZS 17,500 kwa kila mmoja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw:
Ili nihesabu SDL, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.

Ili nihesabu NSSF, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.
rows.adjudication: 'wafanyakazi wangu, AMBAO NI 14 wanaopata kila mmoja TZS 500,000' + two levies. Multi-levy decomposition ALREADY WORKS — v16 emits one clarification per levy. The only gap is parse_count returning None because the noun is separated from the digit by 'wangu, ambao ni'. Judge: v15 UNDETERMINED.

rows.question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata TZS 760,000 na nataka PAYE yake na kama nikiongeza watu wengine 9 kufikia 10, SDL ya jumla ya mishahara ya TZS 7,600,000 itakuwa ngapi?
rows.gold_sw: PAYE ya TZS 760,000 (kikomo cha kundi 3) = 20,000 + 20% x (760,000-520,000) = TZS 68,000. SDL: ukifikia wafanyakazi 10, sasa inatozwa: 3.5% ya TZS 7,600,000 = TZS 266,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa PAYE, tumia fomu ya TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwezi husika. Kwa SDL, ni 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara ya fedha ya wafanyakazi 10, hivyo utakokotoa kwa 7,600,000 x 3.5%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw:
Ili nihesabu SDL, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.

Ili nihesabu PAYE, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.
rows.adjudication: PAYE on TZS 760,000 plus SDL on TZS 7,600,000 after a 9->10 headcount transition. Decomposition works; parse_count correctly DECLINES (_has_second_group sees 'kufikia 10'), and count_transition_ordinal also returns None, so the transition is not detected either. Judge calls v15 CORRECT. A GENUINE REGRESSION.

rows.question_sw: Mwezi Januari nilikuwa na watu 9, Februari nikaongeza mmoja kufikia 10, mishahara ni TZS 3,000,000 kila mwezi — SDL ya Januari na Februari?
rows.gold_sw: Januari: watu 9 (chini ya 10) — HAKUNA SDL. Februari: watu 10 (wamefikia kizingiti) — SDL = 3.5% ya TZS 3,000,000 = TZS 105,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa Januari: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 27,000,000 (jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi 9 × TZS 3,000,000) = TZS 945,000. Kwa Februari: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 28,000,000 (jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi 10 × TZS 3,000,000) = TZS 980,000. Jumlisha pamoja: TZS 945,000 + TZS 980,000 = TZS 1,925,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu SDL, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.
rows.adjudication: multi-period with a headcount transition (Jan 9 -> Feb 10). Pattern F territory; deferred. parse_count correctly declines; count_transition_ordinal returns None here too. Judge: v15 WRONG (v15 multiplied the payroll by the headcount and answered TZS 1,925,000).

rows.question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana mshahara wa msingi TZS 600,000 na posho ya usafiri TZS 150,000 na bonasi ya mara moja TZS 200,000 — PAYE ya mwezi huu?
rows.gold_sw: Mshahara wa jumla unaotozwa (kama posho na bonasi zinahesabika) = 600,000 + 150,000 + 200,000 = TZS 950,000 (kundi 4): PAYE = 68,000 + 25% x (950,000-760,000) = 68,000 + 47,500 = TZS 115,500. Thibitisha aina ya posho na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v15_sw: Kwa mshahara wa msingi TZS 600,000 pekee, PAYE ni TZS 78,000. Posho za usafiri na bonasi zinazolipwa mara moja huongezwa kwenye mshahara wa msingi kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.v16_sw: Ili nihesabu PAYE, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.
rows.adjudication: composition: base 600,000 + allowance 150,000 + one-off bonus 200,000. detect_allowance_ambiguity fires. The gold sums to 950,000 but hedges ('Thibitisha aina ya posho'). Pattern E — logged won't-do pending a locked_facts answer on allowance taxability. Judge: v15 WRONG.
